weather_table.r2_desc: D3 players are exhausted and go to the Reserves after each drive.
weather_table.r3_desc: The sun dazzles the players: -1 to all PASS rolls.
weather_table.r4_10_desc: Ideal conditions for a clean massacre.
weather_table.r11_desc: The ball is slippery: -1 to Pick-up, Catch and Interception.
weather_table.r12_desc: Zero visibility and frozen ground: -1 to Rush (GFI). Only Quick or Short passes.

kickoff_table.r2_desc: Each team receives a free Bribe.
kickoff_table.r3_desc: The turn marker moves back or forward depending on whether the receiving team has already played its turn.
kickoff_table.r4_desc: The team that is NOT kicking may reposition D3+3 players (not on the sideline or in the opponent's half).
kickoff_table.r5_desc: The receiving team may choose any player to catch the ball before it bounces.
kickoff_table.r6_desc: The team that wins the fans roll (or both, on a tie) receives a Prayer to Nuffle.
kickoff_table.r7_desc: Each team rolls 1D6 + Assistant Coaches. The highest gains a free Team Re-roll for this drive.
kickoff_table.r8_desc: Re-roll on the Weather table. The new weather applies immediately.
kickoff_table.r9_desc: The receiving team may activate D3+3 players to move 1 square for free.
kickoff_table.r10_desc: Formerly Blitz. The kicking team may activate D3+3 players to move or Block before the kick-off.
kickoff_table.r11_desc: A random opposing player suffers -1 MA and -1 AV for the rest of the drive.
kickoff_table.r12_desc: A Prayer to Nuffle for the team that is losing or has the lower TV.

injury_table.r1_6_desc: The player leaves the pitch but may return next drive.
injury_table.r7_8_desc: Misses the rest of the match and the Next Game in the league.
injury_table.r9_desc: Long-term injury. +1 to future rolls on this table.
injury_table.r10_desc: Permanent leg injury. MA reduced by 1.
injury_table.r11_desc: Damaged reflexes. AG worsens by 1 (e.g. from 3+ to 4+).
injury_table.r12_desc: Weak spots in their protection. AV reduced by 1.
injury_table.r13_desc: Damaged eyesight or arm. PA worsens by 1.
injury_table.r15_16_desc: The player dies on the spot. Their legend ends here.

prayers_table.r1_desc: A random opposing player falls through a trapdoor and is out for the drive.
prayers_table.r3_desc: A random player gains Stab for the rest of the match.
prayers_table.r4_desc: A random player gains Dauntless for the rest of the match.
prayers_table.r5_desc: A random player gains Mighty Blow (+1) for the rest of the match.
prayers_table.r6_desc: The opponent has -1 to using Team Re-rolls on their next turn.
prayers_table.r7_desc: Opponents suffer -1 to their Dodge rolls.
prayers_table.r8_desc: Your players randomly gain +1 to Stand Firm.
prayers_table.r9_desc: The pitch becomes difficult terrain for the opponent.
prayers_table.r10_desc: Your throwers gain +1 to Passing rolls.
prayers_table.r11_desc: Your fans throw objects, giving -1 to opposing Armour.
prayers_table.r12_desc: The team gains +1 to Injury rolls from Blocks.
prayers_table.r13_desc: Your Fouls do not cause immediate sending-off during this drive.
prayers_table.r14_desc: A fan hits an opposing player (direct Injury roll).
prayers_table.r15_desc: The ref is watching the opponent: when a player is sent off, they cannot use Bribes.
prayers_table.r16_desc: A random player gains a random secondary skill for this match.

skills.Block_desc: The player is not knocked down on a 'Both Down' result. In Season 3 (FF2025), it is considered an elite skill.
skills.Dauntless_desc: Allows you to equal your Strength to that of a stronger opponent with a 1D6 + Strength roll.
skills.Defensive_desc: Agility/General skill from Season 3. During the opponent's turn, any rival marked by this player loses the use of 'Guard' and 'Put the Boot In'.
skills.Fend_desc: The opponent cannot use 'Follow Up' after pushing this player.
skills.Frenzy_desc: Forces a second block if the opponent was pushed but not knocked down.
skills.Kick_desc: Reduces Kick-off deviation to only 1D6 squares.
skills.Kick-off Return_desc: Allows moving up to 3 squares for free after the ball lands if not near the lines.
skills.Pass Block_desc: Allows moving 3 squares to intercept or mark the receiver during a rival Pass action.
skills.Pro_desc: Season 3: Now used with a 3+ on 1D6 (previously 4+). Allows rerolling a failed roll once per turn.
skills.Steady Footing_desc: New Season 3. On a 6 on 1D6, the player avoids becoming Prone or Falling over (Ward Save). Does not cause a Turnover if it occurs in their turn.
skills.Strip Ball_desc: The opponent drops the ball when pushed, unless they have Sure Hands.
skills.Sure Hands_desc: Allows rerolling failed pick-up attempts. Immune to Strip Ball. In Season 3 some versions allow rerolling Catch/Hand-off (depending on race).
skills.Tackle_desc: Negates the rival's use of Dodge when dodging out of your tackle zone.
skills.Taunt_desc: New Season 3. After being pushed or knocked down by a block, forces the opponent to Follow Up if able.
skills.Wrestle_desc: On a 'Both Down' result, both players fall Prone without an armor roll and without a Turnover (usually).
skills.Catch_desc: Allows rerolling any failed Catch roll.
skills.Diving Catch_desc: Can catch the ball in adjacent squares. +1 to catch accurate passes.
skills.Diving Tackle_desc: Season 3: Now also works against Jump and Leap actions. Subtracts -2 from the rival's roll if you go Prone.
skills.Dodge_desc: Reroll one failed dodge per turn. Avoid falling on a 'Stumble' block result.
skills.Hit and Run_desc: New Season 3. After blocking, you can move 1 square for free ignoring Tackle Zones if the rival was moved.
skills.Jump Up_desc: Standing up is free. Blocking from the ground requires an Agility test with +1.
skills.Leap_desc: Season 3: Reduces modifiers for tackle zones when leaping or jumping by 1 (max -1 total).
skills.Safe Pair of Hands_desc: If the player falls with the ball, it doesn't bounce; it is placed in an adjacent square of your choice.
skills.Side Step_desc: The player chooses the square they are pushed into.
skills.Nerves of Steel_desc: Ignore enemy tackle zones for passing or catching.
skills.Regeneration_desc: 4+ chance to ignore a permanent injury suffered.
skills.Right Stuff_desc: This player can be thrown by a teammate with 'Throw Team-mate'.
skills.Stunty_desc: Ignore tackle zones when dodging. Suffers severe penalties to Injury rolls.
skills.Titchy_desc: The player is tiny. Receives +1 to Dodge, but rivals don't suffer tackle zone penalties from them.
skills.Always Hungry_desc: The player might try to eat their teammate when throwing them.
skills.Really Stupid_desc: Fails their activation on 1-3 on 1D6, unless there is a non-stupid teammate adjacent to guide them (then only fails on 1).
skills.Bone Head_desc: Chance to become dazed and lose activation on a 1 on 1D6.
skills.Animal Savagery_desc: Roll 1D6 when activating. On a 1, the player attacks an adjacent teammate (or stays still if no one is there) to act.
skills.Bloodlust (2+)_desc: The player must bite a Thrall teammate after their action if they roll less than 2 on 1D6. If no Thralls, the player leaves the field.
skills.Decay_desc: Due to bodily rot, the player takes two rolls on the Casualty table for each injury suffered.
skills.Unchannelled Fury_desc: Roll 1D6 when activating. On 1-3 (or 1 if Blitzing), the player becomes furious but stays still, losing their activation.
skills.Arm Bar_desc: Season 3: +1 to Armor/Injury roll if the rival fails Dodge/Jump/Leap. Gains SPP for these casualties.
skills.Brawler_desc: Season 3: Reroll a 'Both Down' result in any block (except Blitz).
skills.Break Tackle_desc: Season 3: Grants a modifier to Dodge. +1 (Strength 4 or less), +2 (Strength 5+).
skills.Grab_desc: Choose any free square when pushing. Negates Side Step.
skills.Guard_desc: Season 3: Offers offensive/defensive assistance even when marked. Now also assists in Fouls!
skills.Juggernaut_desc: In a Blitz, converts 'Both Down' to a push. Negates Wrestle and Stand Firm.
skills.Mighty Blow (+X)_desc: Adds (+X) to Armor or Injury rolls after knocking down a rival.
skills.Multiple Block_desc: Blocks two opponents at the same time with a -2 penalty to Strength.
skills.Strong Arm_desc: Adds +1 to Long Passes or Bomb rolls.
skills.Thick Skull_desc: Reduces the effect of KOs in the injury table.
skills.Cannoneer_desc: Adds +1 to Long Pass or Bomb rolls.
skills.Cloud Burster_desc: Forces the rival to ignore interception modifiers on long passes.
skills.Dump-off_desc: Quick pass when being blocked out of your turn.
skills.Hail Mary Pass_desc: Throws the ball anywhere with 2+. Always deviates.
skills.Leader_desc: Gives an extra team reroll while you are playing.
skills.On the Ball_desc: Move 3 squares when the rival passes. +1 to catch the ball from the pass.
skills.Give and Go_desc: Allows continuing a move after releasing the ball.
skills.Running Pass_desc: Season 3: Known as 'Give and Go'. Allows continuing a move after releasing the ball.
skills.Safe Pass_desc: Retain the ball instead of fumbling it.
skills.Big Hand_desc: Ignore tackle zones for picking up the ball from the ground.
skills.Claws_desc: Armor Breaks on a natural 8+. Abrogated by Iron Hard Skin.
skills.Disturbing Presence_desc: Penalizes nearby rival passes and catches with -1.
skills.Extra Arms_desc: Adds +1 to catch, pick up, or intercept.
skills.Foul Appearance_desc: Rival must roll 2+ to be able to block you.
skills.Horns_desc: Adds +1 to Strength when performing a Blitz.
skills.Iron Hard Skin_desc: Season 3: Immune to Armor modifiers and negates the rival's Claws skill.
skills.Monstrous Mouth_desc: Season 3: Reroll Catch. Immune to Strip Ball. Allows 'Chomp' action to damage the rival.
skills.Prehensile Tail_desc: Opponents suffer -1 to dodge out of your reach.
skills.Tentacles_desc: Season 3: Blocks rival movement with a 6+ roll on 1D6 (modified by Strength).
skills.Very Long Legs_desc: Skill heavily affected by Season 3 Jump/Leap changes. +1 to Intercept.
skills.Dirty Player (+X)_desc: Season 3: Relocated to Devious. Adds (+X) to Armor/Injury in Fouls.
skills.Eye Gouge_desc: Season 3. If you push a rival, they cannot assist in any block until their next turn.
skills.Fumblerooski_desc: Season 3: Relocated to Devious. Leave the ball on the ground without causing a Turnover.
skills.Lethal Flight_desc: Season 3. If you are thrown and collide with a rival, add +1 to their Armor or Injury roll.
skills.Pile Driver_desc: Season 3: Relocated to Devious. Allows performing a free Foul after knocking down a rival.
skills.Quick Foul_desc: Season 3. Perform a Foul without immediately ending your activation.
skills.Saboteur_desc: Season 3. If you are knocked down, the rival also has a chance to fall with you via sabotage.
skills.Shadowing_desc: Season 3: Relocated to Devious. Now activates with a natural 4+ on 1D6.
skills.Sneaky Git_desc: Season 3: Relocated to Devious. Reduces expulsion risk and allows moving after the foul.
skills.Violent Innovator_desc: Season 3. Gain SPP for casualties caused with special actions (Stab, Projectile Vomit, etc.).
skills.Hatred (Target)_desc: When this player blocks an opposition player with the specified keyword/tag in parentheses, they may re-roll a single Block die.
skills.Animosity (Target)_desc: The player may refuse to pass or hand off the ball to a teammate of a specific race (or all races). Requires a 2+ test.
skills.Ball & Chain_desc: Destructive and random movement. Cannot mark or catch.
skills.Bloodlust (X+)_desc: The player must bite a Thrall teammate after their action if they roll less than X on 1D6. If no Thralls, the player leaves the field.
skills.Bullseye_desc: New Season 3. Drastically improves accuracy when throwing teammates (Throw Team-mate).
skills.Drunkard_desc: The player has -1 to GFI (Rush) rolls and cannot use Passing skills.
skills.Hypnotic Gaze_desc: Special Action: The player can try to hypnotize an adjacent rival with an AG test. If successful, the rival loses their tackle zones.
skills.Insignificant_desc: This player is so small they don't count towards the field limit if they are a secondary Snotling (Swarming rules).
skills.Loner (X+)_desc: To use a team RR with this player, you must roll X+ on 1D6.
skills.No Hands_desc: The player cannot pick up, catch, or intercept the ball, nor perform actions requiring hands.
skills.Pick-me-up_desc: At the end of the opposition's team turn, you may roll a D6 for each Prone, non-Stunned teammate within 3 squares of this standing player. On a 5+, that teammate may immediately stand up.
skills.Plague Ridden_desc: If this player causes a casualty on a human opponent, there is a chance they turn into a new Rotter for your team.
skills.Pogo Stick_desc: Allows the player to perform leaps (Leap) more easily and ignore some movement penalties.
skills.Projectile Vomit_desc: Attacks an adjacent rival with acid vomit. If you hit, you perform a direct armor roll.
skills.Punt_desc: New Season 3. Allows kicking the ball forward as a special tactical action.
skills.Secret Weapon_desc: The player will be sent off by the referee at the end of the half they played in, unless you use a Bribe.
skills.Stab_desc: Uses a dagger to attack the rival's armor directly instead of blocking.
skills.Swarming_desc: At the start of a drive, you can place D3 extra players with this skill on the field above the 11-player limit.
skills.Take Root_desc: If you roll a 1 when activating, the player takes root and their Movement is reduced to 0 for the rest of the half.
skills.Throw Team-mate_desc: Season 3: No longer considered a Pass action; allows throwing teammates with 'Right Stuff'.
skills.Timber!_desc: Helps Treemen stand up. They receive a bonus for each adjacent teammate.
skills.Unsteady_desc: This player may not declare Secure the Ball Actions.
skills.Trickster_desc: When an opposing player attempts a Block action against this player, or a Special action that directly targets this player (except a Block action caused by the Ball & Chain Special action), this player may use this Trait. Before determining how many dice are rolled, this player may be removed from the pitch and placed in any other unoccupied square adjacent to the opposing player performing the action.
skills.Lone Fouler_desc: Season 3. Allows re-rolling a failed Armour roll when making a Foul if there are no offensive or defensive assists.
skills.Put the Boot In_desc: Season 3. Grants offensive assists on Foul actions regardless of how many opponents are marking this player.
skills.My ball_desc: This player may not voluntarily Pass or Hand-off the ball to a team-mate.

akhorne.name: Blind Rage
akhorne.desc: Akhorne may choose to re-roll the D6 when rolling for the Dauntless Skill.

anqi.name: Savage Blow
anqi.desc: Once per game, when Anqi performs a Block Action against an opposition player he may choose to re-roll any number of the Block Dice.

barik.name: Blast It!
barik.desc: Whenever Barik makes a Hail Mary Pass, he may re-roll any Scatter results for determining where the ball lands, and any team-mate attempting to catch the ball applies a +1 modifier to the roll.

bilerot.name: Putrid Regurgitation
bilerot.desc: Once per half, Bilerot may use the Projectile Vomit Special Action. This may still be used even if Bilerot has already performed a Block Action this Turn.

boa.name: Look into my Eyes
boa.desc: Once per game, if Boa begins his activation Marking an opposition player in possession of the ball, he may roll a D6. On a 1, nothing happens. On a 2+ the opposition player losses possession of the ball, Boa immediately gains possession of the ball, and Boa’s activation immediately ends.

bomber.name: Kaboom!
bomber.desc: Once per game, if an opposition player catches a bomb thrown by Bomber, you can choose to have it explode rather than the opposition player immediate attempting to throw it again.

karina.name: Tasty Morsel
karina.desc: Once per game, when Karina fails a Bloodlust roll, she may choose to bite an opposition player with a ST of 3 or lower as if they were a Thrall Lineman team-mate. Karina may not bite Star Players with this special rule.

cindy.name: All You Can Eat
cindy.desc: Once per game, Ciindy may perform two Throw Bomb Special Actions rather than one; though she must commit to doing so before making the first Action. If she does, immediately after performing the second Throw Bomb Special Action, roll a D6. On a 1-3, Cindy is immediately Sent-off.

luthor.name: Star of the Show
luthor.desc: Once per game, when Count Luthor scores a Touchdown, his controlling coach gains one Team Re-roll until the end of the following Drive. If this Team Re-roll has not been used by the end of the next Drive, it is lost.

deeproot.name: Reliable
deeproot.desc: If Deeproot makes a Fumbled Throw when performing a Throw Team-mate Action, the player that was being thrown will Bounce as normal but will automatically land safely.

dribl_drull.name: A Sneaky Pair
dribl_drull.desc: - Dribl & Drull mist be hired as a pair. , Additionally, whenever Dribl or Drull perform either a Foul Action or a Stab Special Action against an opposition player Marked by both Dribl & Drull, they may apply a +1 modifier to the roll.

eldril.name: Mesmerizing Gaze
eldril.desc: Once per half, Eldril may re-roll the dice when performing a Hypnotic Gaze Special Action.

estelle.name: Baleful Hex
estelle.desc: Once per game, at the beginning of Estelle’s activation, she may select an opposition player within 5 squares and roll a D6. On a 2+, the selected player becomes Distracted and cannot be activated during their team’s next Turn.

fungus.name: Whirling Dervish
fungus.desc: Once per Activation, Fungus may re-roll the D6 when determining which direction he moves in.

glart.name: Frenzied Rush
glart.desc: Once per half, when Glart declares a Blitz Action he may gain the Frenzy Skill until the end of his activation. Glatt may not use the Grab Skill during a Turn in which he uses this special rule.

gloriel.name: Shot to Nothing
gloriel.desc: Once per game, when Gloriel is activated she may use this special rule. If she does, Gloriel gains the Hail Mary Pass Skill until the end of her activation.

glotl.name: Primal Savagery
glotl.desc: One per game, when Glotl fails an Animal Savagery roll, it may lash out at an opposition player rather than a team-mate.,

grak_crumble.name: I'll Carry You - Grak & Grumbleberry must be hired as a pair.
grak_crumble.desc: Additionally, once per half, if Grak begins his activation adjacent to Crumbleberry he may pick up Crumbleberry; temporarily remove Crumbleberry from the pitch. At the end of Grak’s activation, place Crumbleberry in an unoccupied square adjacent to Grak. Additional, whilst Crumbleberry is being carried by Grak, Grak gains the Break Tackle and Dodge Skills.

grashnak.name: Gored by the Bull
grashnak.desc: Once per game wen Grashnak performs a Block Action as part of a Blitz Action, he may roll one additional Block Dice against the opposition player regardless of their ST, to a maximum of three Block Dice. If Grashnak performs a second Block Action due to the Frenzy Skill, the second Block Action will also benefit from this rule.

gretchen.name: Incorporeal
gretchen.desc: Once per game, when Gretchen is activated she can use this special rule. Until the end of her activation, Gretchen does not have to make Dodge rolls for leaving a square within an opposition player’s Tackle Zone.

griff.name: Consummate Professional
griff.desc: Once per game, Griff may apple a +1 modifier to an Agility Test he has made. This modifier may be applied after the roll has been made.

grim.name: Slayer
grim.desc: Once per game, when an opposition Big Guy is Knocked Down as a result of a Block Action performed by Grim, you may apply an additional +1 modifier to either the Armour Roll or the Injury Roll. This modifier may be applied after the roll has been made.

grombrindal.name: Wisdom of the White Dwarf
grombrindal.desc: Once per game, when Grombrindal is activated he may select one team-mate within 2 squares. The selected team-mate gains one of the following Skills until the end of turn: Break Tackle, Dauntless, Mighty Blow, Sure Feet

guffle.name: Quick Bite
guffle.desc: Once per game, if Guffle is Marking an opposition player who catches the ball, he may immediately make an Armour Roll against that player. If the target’s Armour is broken, Guffle immediately gains possession of the ball. No Turnover is caused as a result of using this special rule.

hakflem.name: Treacherous
hakflem.desc: Once per game, if Hakflem is adjacent to a teammate who is in possession of the ball when he is activated, then Hakflem can choose to gain possession of the ball. If he does, then the team-mate will immediately be Knocked Down. This will not cause a Turnover even if the team-mate suffers a Casualty.

helmut.name: Old Pro
helmut.desc: Once per game, Helmut may use his Pro Skill to re-roll a single dice rolled as art of an Armour Roll.

hthark.name: Unstoppable Momentum
hthark.desc: Whenever H’Thark performs a Block Action as part of a Blitz Action, he may re-roll a single Block Dice.

ivan.name: Dwarfen Scourge
ivan.desc: Once per game, when an opposition player is Knocked Down as a result of a Block Action performed by Ivan, you may apply an additional +1 modifier to the Armour Roll or Injury roll. If this is against a Dwarf player this may instead be a +2 modifier.,

ivar.name: Raiding Party
ivar.desc: Once per Drive, when Ivar begins his activation he may select one Open team-mate within 5 squares. The selected player may immediately move 1 square though they must end this move Marking an opposition player.

jeremiah.name: The Flashing Blade
jeremiah.desc: Once per game, at the start of his activation, Jeremiah may declare a Stab Special Action against an opposition player he is Marking. After performing the Stab Special Action, Jeremiah may then perform a Move Action before his activation ends.

jordell.name: Swift as the Breeze
jordell.desc: Once per game, Jordell can choose to pass a single Dodge, Leap, or Rush Test on a 2+, regardless of any modifiers.

josef.name: Dwarfen Grit
josef.desc: Once per game, when Josef's armour is broken as the result of an Armour Roll, you may choose to have the Armour Roll re-rolled.

karla.name: Indomitable
karla.desc: Once per game, when Karla successfully rolls to use her Dauntless Skill, she may increase her ST characteristic to double that of the target of the Block Action.

kiroth.name: Black Ink
kiroth.desc: Once per game, at the start of any of his activations, Kiroth can select an opposition player he is Marking. The selected player becomes Distracted until they are next activated.

kreek.name: I'll Be Back!
kreek.desc: The first time in a game that Kreek would be Sent-off as per the Secret Weapon Trait, he is not Sent-off and may instead continue as part of the game. Kreek’s coach may not Argue the Call when Kreek uses this special rule.

borak.name: Lord of Chaos
borak.desc: Once per game, when Lord Borak performs a Block Action he may re-roll a single Block Dice.

swift_twins.name: Working In Tandem -The Swift Twins must be hired as a pair.
swift_twins.desc: Additionally, if Lucien performs a Block Action against an opposition player who is also Marked be Valen, Lucien may re-roll a single Block Dice. Additionally, if Valen performs a Pass Action that targets a square containing Lucien, then Valen suffers no modifiers to the PA Test for the range of the Pass Action.

maple.name: Vicious Vines
maple.desc: Once per half, when Maple declares a Block Action he may do so against an opposition player who is 2 squares away following all the normal rules for performing a Block Action, though he may not follow-up.

max.name: Maximum Carnage
max.desc: Once per game, after Max performs a Chainsaw Attack Special Action he may immediately perform another Chainsaw Attack Special Action that targets a different opposition player.

zug.name: Crushing Blow
zug.desc: Once per game, when an opposition player is Knocked Down as the result of a Block Action performed by Zug, you may apply an additional +1 modifier to the Armour Roll. This modifier may be apple after the Armour Roll has been made.

morg.name: The Ballista
morg.desc: Once per game, when Morg performs a Throw Team-mate Action, he may re-roll the Passing Ability Test.

nobbla.name: Kick 'em While They're Down!
nobbla.desc: Once per game, Nobbla may use the Chainsaw Attack Special Action against a Prone or Stunned opposition player. This does not count as a Foul Action and so Nobbla cannot be Sent-off when using this special rule.

puggy.name: Halfling Luck
puggy.desc: Once per game, Puggy may re-roll a single dice that was rolled either as a signal dice roll, a multiple dice roll, or a dice pool, though this cannot be a dice that was rolled as a part of an Armour Roll, Injury Roll or Casualty Roll.,

rashnak.name: Toxin Connoisseur
rashnak.desc: Once per game, when Rashnak successfully breaks an opposition player’s armour as a result of a Stab Special Action, you may apply an additional +1 modifier to the Injury Roll. This modifier may be applied after the roll has been made.

ripper.name: Thinking Man's Troll
ripper.desc: Once per half, Ripper may re-roll a single dice that was rolled either as a signal dice roll, a multiple dice roll, or a dice pool, though this cannot be a dice that was rolled as a part of an Armour Roll, Injury Roll or Casualty Roll.

rodney.name: Catch of the Day
rodney.desc: Once per half, if Rodney is Standing and begins his activation within 3 squares of a ball which is on the ground he may roll a d6. On a 1-2 nothing happens. On a 3+ Rodney immediately gains possession of the ball.

roxanna.name: Slashing Nails
roxanna.desc: Once per half, when Roxanna declares a Blitz Action, she gains the Claws Skill until the end of her activation.

rumbelow.name: Ram
rumbelow.desc: Once per game, when an opposition player is Knocked Down as a result of a Block Action performed by Rumbelow, you may apply an additional +1 modifier to either the Armour Roll or the Injury Roll. This modifier may be applied after the roll has been made.

scrappa.name: Yoink!
scrappa.desc: Once per game, when Scrappa attempts to Intercept a Pass Action he may roll a D6. On a 2+, Scrappa doesn’t need to roll to Intercept; instead, he will automatically Intercept the Pass Action and gains control of the ball.

scyla.name: Fury of the Blood God
scyla.desc: Once per game, if Scyla rolls a 1 for his Unchannelled Fury roll after declaring a Block Action then, instead of applying the usual effects of Unchanneled Fury, Scyla may perform two Block Actions instead. The first Block Action must be fully resolved, including the use of the Frenzy Skill, before the second one is performed.

skitter.name: Master Assassin
skitter.desc: Oncer per game, when Skitter performs a Stab Special Action, he may choose to re-roll the Armour Roll.

skrorg.name: Pump Up the Crowd
skrorg.desc: Once per game, when Skrorg causes an opposition player to be removed as a Casualty as the result of a Block Action, Skrorg’s controlling coach gains one Team Re-roll until the end of the current Drive. If this Team Re-roll has not been used by the end of the Drive, it is lost.

skrull.name: Strong Passing Game
skrull.desc: Once per game, when Skrull performs a Pass Action he may modify the result of the Passing Ability Test by the value of his ST characteristic, to a maximum of 6.

swiftvine.name: Furious Outburst
swiftvine.desc: Once per half, so long as she is Standing at the start of her activation, Swiftvine can place herself adjacent to a Standing opposition player within 3 squares of her and immediately make a Stab Special Action against them. She may then place herself in an unoccupied square within 3 squares of her new position. Her action then immediately ends. This counts as the team’s Blitz Action for the turn.

thorsson.name: Beer Barrel Bash!
thorsson.desc: Once per Drive, at the start of his activation, Thorsson may select an opposition player within three squares and roll a D6. On a 3+, the selected player is immediately Knocked Down. On a 2, nothing happens. On a 1, Thorsson Falls Over. After using this special rule, Thorsson’s activation immediately ends.

varag.name: Krump and Smash
varag.desc: Once per game, when an opposition player is Knocked Down as a result of a Block Action performed by Varag, he may re-roll the Armour Roll.

wilhelm.name: Savage Mauling
wilhelm.desc: Once per game, when Wilhelm makes in Injury Roll against an opposition player, he may choose to re-roll the result.

willow.name: Woodland Fury
willow.desc: Once per game, when Willow performs a Block Action that would result in her being Knocked Down, she can choose to re-roll a single Block Dice.

withergrasp.name: Watch Out!
withergrasp.desc: The first time each Drive that Withergrasp is the target of a block Action performed by an opposition player, he counts as having the Dodge Skill.

zolcath.name: Excuse Me, Are You a Zoat
zolcath.desc: ?, Once per game, when Zolcatch is activated he may select an opposition player within 3 squares. The selected player immediately loses their Tackle Zone until they are next activated.

zzharg.name: "Blastin' Solves Everything"
zzharg.desc: Once per half, at the start of his activation, Zzharg may select a Standing opposition player within 3 squares and roll a D6. On a 3+, the selected player is hit. On a 2, the opposition coach selects a player (from either team, but not Zzharg) within 3 squares of the originally selected player to be hit instead. On a 1, Zzharg is hit instead. Make an Armour Roll for whichever player is hit. Zzharg’s activation then immediately ends.

expensive_mistakes.catastrophe: CATASTROPHE!: the treasurer has run off with almost everything.

get_the_ref.name: Get the Ref
get_the_ref.desc: Each team immediately receives a free Bribe. It must be used before the end of the match or it is lost.

time_out.name: Time-out
time_out.desc: If the kicking team's turn marker is on turn 6, 7 or 8 of the half, both coaches move their turn marker back one space. Otherwise, both move their marker forward one space.

solid_defence.name: Solid Defence
solid_defence.desc: D3+3 Open players on the kicking team may be set up again, following the normal set-up restrictions.

high_kick.name: High Kick
high_kick.desc: One Open player on the receiving team may immediately be placed in the square where the ball will land.

cheering_fans.name: Cheering Fans
cheering_fans.desc: Both coaches roll 1D6 and add their Cheerleaders. The coach with the higher result (or both, on a tie) gets an extra offensive assist on the first Block action of their next turn.

brilliant_coaching.name: Brilliant Coaching
brilliant_coaching.desc: Both coaches roll 1D6 and add their Assistant Coaches. The winner (or both, on a tie) gains an extra Team Re-roll for this drive.

changing_weather.name: Changing Weather
changing_weather.desc: Roll again on the Weather table and apply the result. If the result is Perfect Conditions, the ball scatters (Scatter 3) in the air before landing.

quick_snap.name: Quick Snap
quick_snap.desc: The receiving team selects D3+3 Open players. They may move one square in any direction, even into the opponent's half.

charge.name: Charge!
charge.desc: The kicking team selects D3+3 Open players and activates them one at a time to perform a free Move action. One player may perform a free Blitz, one a free Throw Team-mate and one a free Kick Team-mate.

dodgy_snack.name: Dodgy Snack
dodgy_snack.desc: Both coaches roll 1D6. The lower (or both, on a tie) picks a random player and rolls 1D6: on a 2+ their MA and AV are reduced by 1 for this drive due to indigestion. On a 1, they go straight to the Reserves box because they're stuck in the toilet.

pitch_invasion.name: Pitch Invasion
pitch_invasion.desc: Both coaches roll 1D6 + Fan Factor. The coach with the lower result (or both, on a tie) picks D3 random players on the pitch: they are Placed Prone and become Stunned.

bloodweiser_keg.name: Bloodweiser Kegs
bloodweiser_keg.desc: Each keg adds +1 to rolls to recover KO'd players.

bribes.name: Bribes
bribes.desc: Lets you try to cancel a sending-off on a 2+ on 1D6.

extra_training.name: Extra Team Training
extra_training.desc: Extra Team Re-rolls for this match only.

wandering_apothecary.name: Wandering Apothecary
wandering_apothecary.desc: An additional Apothecary for the match. Can be used on any player.

mortuary_assistant.name: Mortuary Assistant
mortuary_assistant.desc: Lets you re-roll a FAILED "Raise the Dead" result.

plague_doctor.name: Plague Doctor
plague_doctor.desc: Lets you re-roll a "Badly Hurt" result on one of your own players (once).

halfling_master_chef.name: Halfling Master Chef
halfling_master_chef.desc: Steals 1D3 Team Re-rolls from the opponent on a 4+ per die at the start of each half.

prayers_to_nuffle.name: Prayers to Nuffle
prayers_to_nuffle.desc: One random prayer from the Prayers to Nuffle table.

biased_referee.name: Biased Referee
biased_referee.desc: The ref ignores Fouls on natural doubles and gives +1 to Argue the Call.

part_time_assistant.name: Part-time Assistant Coach
part_time_assistant.desc: Extra Assistant Coaches for the match.

hireling_sports_wizard.name: Hireling Sports-Wizard
hireling_sports_wizard.desc: Casts a Fireball (4+), a Lightning Bolt (2+) or a Zap! (transformation 2+) once per match.

weather_mage.name: Weather Mage
weather_mage.desc: Lets you change the weather once per match (4+).

unusual.name: Unusual Surface
unusual.desc: The pitch has highly unusual conditions that affect falls and how the ball bounces.

rundown.name: Run-down Stadium
rundown.desc: Shoddy facilities whose owners care more about blood than upkeep.

normal.name: Completely Normal
normal.desc: A regulation pitch, well-kept facilities and no special attributes.

luxury.name: Luxury Stadium
luxury.desc: VIP boxes, first-class amenities and a wealthy crowd ready to spend.

peculiar.name: Peculiar Local Crowd
peculiar.desc: The local crowd has unique customs and reactions that shape the match.

1.name: Ankle-deep Water
1.desc: The pitch is flooded under several centimetres of water. Whenever a player falls over, their Armour roll suffers a -1. In addition, when a Stunned player rolls over at the end of either team's turn, roll a D6. On a 1 they have ended up face down in the water and remain Stunned for another turn.
1.short: -1 to Armour rolls when falling. Stunned players stay Stunned on a 1 on 1D6.

2.name: Sloping Pitch
2.desc: The stadium is built on a steep slope. At the start of the first drive, roll a D6. On a 4+ the slope runs down towards the kicking team's End Zone; on a 1-3 it runs down towards the receiving team's. When the ball bounces, use the Throw-in template instead of the Random Direction template, oriented so that 3-4 points downhill. Players may attempt one additional Rush as long as that move takes them closer to the downhill End Zone. After half-time the teams swap ends and the slope runs the other way.
2.short: Ball bounces using the Throw-in template pointing downhill. +1 Rush towards the downhill End Zone.

3.name: Ice
3.desc: When the ball bounces, it moves two squares instead of one, in the direction given by a D8 on the Random Direction template. When a player falls over or is Knocked Down, they slide one square in a direction determined the same way. If that square is occupied, they stay where they are. If they slide off the pitch, they risk injury by the crowd as normal. If they slide into the square containing the ball, the ball bounces. Players are assumed to wear suitable gear for the ice, so their normal movement is unaffected.
3.short: The ball bounces 2 squares. Fallen players slide 1 square in a random D8 direction.

4.name: Astrogranite
4.desc: This artificial surface is extremely grippy. Whenever a player falls over or is Knocked Down on it, their Armour roll gets +1. In addition, if a player falls over after failing a Rush, roll a D6. On a 4+ they stay on their feet but may not attempt any more Rushes that activation. On a 1-3 they fall over as normal.
4.short: +1 to Armour rolls from falls. Failed Rush: a 4+ on 1D6 avoids falling over.

5.name: Uneven Ground
5.desc: The pitch is full of bumps and holes. All players have -1 MA for the match, never going below MA3. In exchange, all players may attempt one more Rush than normal during their activation. Most can make three Rushes, and those with a skill like Sprint can make four.
5.short: -1 MA to all players (minimum MA3). In exchange, +1 Rush allowed per activation.

6.name: Solid Stone
6.desc: The pitch is polished stone, like the marble of Dwarf stadiums. When the ball bounces, it moves two squares instead of one, in the direction given by a D8 on the Random Direction template. In addition, whenever a player falls over or is Knocked Down on the stone, their Armour roll gets +1.
6.short: The ball bounces 2 squares in a D8 direction. +1 to Armour when falling or Knocked Down.

1.name: Apathetic Officials
1.desc: At the start of each half, each team receives a free Bribe Inducement. If a team does not use the first-half Bribe, it starts the second half with two.
1.short: 1 free Bribe for each team at the start of each half (they stack).

2.name: Dilapidated Stands
2.desc: The stands are uncomfortable and dangerous, and the fans may leave. At the end of each drive, both coaches roll a D6. On a 2+ their fans stick around. On a 1 they start to leave and that team's Fan Factor drops by 1, but never below 0.
2.short: End of drive: roll 1D6 per team. On a 1, its Fan Factor drops by 1.

3.name: Uncovered Trapdoors
3.desc: The pitch's trapdoors are just open holes. Any player who enters a trapdoor square, voluntarily or pushed, is removed from play and treated exactly as if they had been pushed into the crowd. If the ball comes to rest in a trapdoor square, a stadium employee returns it to the pitch and the ball immediately scatters from that square.
3.short: Open trapdoor squares: falling into or entering one removes the player as if pushed into the crowd.

4.name: Faded Lines
4.desc: The pitch barely has any markings. When the kicking team sets up for a drive, it may decide that its Line of Scrimmage is the normal one, one row further back in its own half, or one row further forward into the opponent's half. That line acts as a temporary halfway line for that kick-off. The receiving team must respect it when setting up, and it is also used to decide whether there is a touchback. In addition, neither team has to respect the two-players-per-Wide-Zone limit during set-up.
4.short: The kicking team may move the Line of Scrimmage by 1 square. No 2-player limit in the Wide Zones.

5.name: Desperate for Publicity
5.desc: The owners want to improve their stadium's reputation and pay teams to play there. In Step 1 of the post-game sequence, make a single D6 roll; each team adds that result multiplied by 10,000 gold pieces to its winnings.
5.short: Post-game: an extra 1D6 × 10,000 gp in winnings for each team.

6.name: Poorly Built Dungeons
6.desc: The cells where sent-off players are locked up are far from secure. In Step 2 of the end-of-drive sequence, each coach rolls a D6 for each of their sent-off players, whatever the reason. On a 5+ that player escapes and returns to the Reserves box.
6.short: End of drive: on a 5+ on 1D6, a sent-off player escapes the cell and returns to the Reserves.

1.name: Built-in Merchandise Stalls
1.desc: The teams get a cut of what's sold in the stadium. In Step 1 of the post-game sequence, each coach rolls a D3 and adds that result multiplied by 10,000 gp to their winnings.
1.short: Post-game: each coach rolls 1D3 × 10,000 gp extra for their winnings.

2.name: Reputation for Spectacle
2.desc: Promoters give the teams money to make the match a spectacle. In Step 4 of the pre-game sequence, each coach rolls a D6. Add the two results together and multiply by 10,000; each team receives that amount in cash to spend on Inducements.
2.short: Pre-game: (home 1D6 + away 1D6) × 10,000 gp in cash for both teams' Inducements.

3.name: Broadcast Studio
3.desc: Matches in this stadium are broadcast live and the sport's big names want to be seen. In Step 4 of the pre-game sequence, Star Players, Mercenary Players, (In)Famous Coaching Staff, named Wizards and Biased Referees can be hired for D3 × 10,000 gp less than normal, with a minimum price of 10,000 gp. The discount is rolled separately for each Inducement you want to hire.
3.short: Star/special Inducements get a 1D3 × 10,000 gp discount (minimum 10,000 gp).

4.name: In-house Medics
4.desc: In Step 4 of the pre-game sequence, each team that can hire an Apothecary receives a free Wandering Apothecary Inducement. Teams that cannot have an Apothecary receive something else according to their special rule: with “Masters of Undeath” they get a free Mortuary Assistant; with “Favoured of Nurgle” they get a free Plague Doctor.
4.short: 1 free Wandering Apothecary (or Mortuary Assistant / Plague Doctor if they can't have an Apothecary).

5.name: Enclosed Pitch
5.desc: The pitch is surrounded by a high wall or sunk into a pit, with the crowd far above. No player can be pushed into the crowd for any reason. If a push would take them off the pitch, the player hits the wall and is Knocked Down in the square they occupy. The ball cannot bounce into the crowd either, although it can still end up there from a deviating kick-off or a Pass action. When a bounce would send it off the pitch, it rebounds off the wall: the direction is determined with the Throw-in template as usual, but the ball only travels one square from the wall instead of 2D6. Players thrown by a team-mate can still land in the crowd as normal.
5.short: Perimeter walls: pushes into the crowd Knock the player Down in their square with no crowd injury.

6.name: Luxury Seating
6.desc: The crowd is comfortable and in a good mood, and the teams feel it. In every start-of-drive sequence except the first, between Steps 2 and 3, each coach rolls a D3 and adds their team's current Dedicated Fans. If the total exceeds their team's Fan Factor for this match, they gain an extra Team Re-roll for that drive. If it isn't used before the drive ends, it is lost.
6.short: Start of drive (except the 1st): 1D3 + Dedicated Fans > Fan Factor grants 1 Team Re-roll for that drive.

1.name: Drunken Maniacs
1.desc: At the start of each drive, before rolling on the Kick-off Event table, roll a D6. In the first half, on a 1 you don't roll on that table and roll another D6 instead. In the second half the same happens on a 1 or 2. On that second D6, a 1 is resolved as “Get the Ref!”, a 2-3 as Time-out, a 4-5 as Officious Ref and a 6 as Pitch Invasion.
1.short: Before the Kick-off: a 1 on 1D6 (1-2 in the 2nd half) replaces the event with an alternative drunken table.

2.name: Rowdy Rabble
2.desc: The crowd wants to join in and stadium security can barely hold them back. Each coach's Fan Factor increases by 1. If a player is pushed into the crowd, their Injury roll gets +1. If Pitch Invasion is ever rolled on the Kick-off Event table, the D3 that determines how many players are affected gets +1.
2.short: +1 Fan Factor for both. +1 to crowd Injury rolls. +1 to players affected by Pitch Invasion.

3.name: Know-it-alls
3.desc: The crowd shouts every detail of the rulebook at the ref. If a player commits a Foul that removes their victim from the pitch but the ref doesn't send them off, roll a D6. On a 4+ the ref ignores the shouting. On a 1-3 they listen and the player is sent off.
3.short: Injuring Foul without a sending-off: on a 1-3 on 1D6 the crowd pressures the ref and the fouler is sent off.

4.name: Pacifists
4.desc: The crowd likes watching violence, not taking part in it. If Pitch Invasion is rolled on the Kick-off table, re-roll it. If a player is pushed into the crowd, roll a D6. On a 4+ they suffer no injury and go straight to their team's Reserves box. On a 1-3 they are injured by the crowd as normal.
4.short: Re-roll Pitch Invasion. Pushed into the crowd: on a 4+ on 1D6 the player goes to the Reserves uninjured.

5.name: Fickle Crowd
5.desc: Much of the crowd isn't all that interested. At the end of each drive, roll a D6. On a 2+ the fans stay a while longer. On a 1 they start to leave and both teams lose 1 Fan Factor, never going below 0. In addition, when the ball goes off the pitch, except on the last turn of the half, roll a D6. On a 4+ it is returned as normal. On a 1-3 nobody returns it until the end of the next team turn. In both cases the throw-in is taken as normal from the last square the ball occupied before leaving the pitch.
5.short: End of drive: on a 1 on 1D6 both lose 1 Fan Factor. A ball out of bounds is returned late on a 1-3.

6.name: Solemn and Silent
6.desc: The crowd only allows itself polite applause. For the whole match, Cheerleaders have no effect on Kick-off Event table results. If a player is pushed into the crowd, they suffer no injury and may return to play at the start of their team's next turn. When they return this way, they are placed Prone in a square next to the sideline, as close as possible to the square they left from.
6.short: Cheerleaders have no effect on the Kick-off. Players pushed into the crowd are not injured and return Prone at the sideline.
